$comment: Operational and safety thresholds. Changing this file is a reviewed config change, not an API or UI knob. Restricted-live caps must never be loosened via settings. Numbers preserve pre-extraction behavior.
_fastLaneMaxConcurrentEvaluationsComment: 2026-10-06 (Fast Opportunity Lane Evaluator): resource governor bounding how many real strategy evaluations (quantSignalAgent.evaluateSymbol, real bar fetches) the fast lane may run concurrently - prevents an evaluation fan-out from flooding the historical-bar provider. Not a trading threshold.
_fastLaneSymbolEvaluationCooldownMsComme: 2026-10-06: minimum real time between two evaluations of the SAME symbol through the fast-lane evaluator, preventing duplicate-evaluation races / bar-request storms from repeated near-simultaneous detection events (e.g. several news catalysts for the same symbol in a short window).
_fastLaneEvaluationTimeoutMsComment: 2026-10-08 (fast-lane D4 defect fix): liveness watchdog for a single fast-lane strategy evaluation. If quantSignalAgent.evaluateSymbol() never settles (hung bar fetch, wedged promise), the evaluation is abandoned, the candidate is terminally transitioned, and the concurrency slot is released - three hung evaluations must never wedge the lane until restart. Generous on purpose: a slow-but-working evaluation must never false-positive. Not a trading threshold.
_fastLaneHungLeaseMaxConsecutiveTimeouts: 2026-10-09 (P1 fast-lane lease fix, hung-work Part 4): consecutive caller-timeouts for ONE symbol after which its lease is QUARANTINED - the concurrency slot is returned to the pool (capacity recovers) while the dedup entry is kept so no replacement concurrent evaluation can start for that symbol. evaluateSymbol() accepts no AbortSignal and the gateway fetch has no timeout/cancel path, so quarantine (not cancellation) is the bounded recovery. Resource governor, not a trading threshold.
_fastLaneHungLeaseMaxAgeMsComment: 2026-10-09 (P1 fast-lane lease fix, hung-work Part 4): maximum lease age (ms) before quarantine even without consecutive timeouts - the backstop guaranteeing a permanently hung task can never hold Fast Lane capacity forever. Same quarantine semantics: slot recovered, dedup entry kept, late settle discarded and never double-applied. Resource governor, not a trading threshold.
_fastLaneCanonicalIdeaCacheMaxEntriesCom: 2026-10-08 (fast-lane D5 defect fix): bound for the in-memory evidence-fingerprint idempotency cache in fastCanonicalDedup.ts, whose own header claimed 'bounded' while the Map only ever grew. Oldest-first eviction past this size. Not a trading threshold.
_quantPrioritySchedulerComment: 2026-10-09 (P2 scheduler mission, Task C): knobs for src/server/scheduling/quantPriorityScheduler.ts - the bounded priority-aware quant scheduling control-plane. Priority affects WHEN a candidate is evaluated, NEVER any gate/threshold/strategy outcome. Pool sizes are conservative starting values; the measurement procedure to raise them with evidence is docs/testing/QUANT_SCHEDULER_CAPACITY.md. SLA values are user-endorsed certification targets. None of these are trading thresholds.
_quantSchedulerQuantWorkerPoolSizeCommen: Bounded pool for evaluateSymbol() calls. 4 keeps per-symbol CPU work (regime + strategies over 400 daily bars) bounded; the gateway's own Alpaca pace chain (<=150/min) + per-window coalescing + reactive 429 backoff remain the provider burst protection. Raise only after measuring provider headroom (see QUANT_SCHEDULER_CAPACITY.md).
_quantSchedulerDataFetchPoolSizeComment: Separate bounded pool for scheduler-initiated ensureBars() pre-fetches. A slow provider fetch for symbol A must never hold a quant compute slot needed by B/C/D.
_quantSchedulerMaxQueueDepthComment: Admission queue bound. On overflow the lowest-priority queued candidate strictly below the newcomer's priority is terminally EVICTED (PREEMPTED_BY_HIGHER_PRIORITY); if none exists the newcomer itself is EVICTED (QUEUE_FULL).
_quantSchedulerDataFetchTimeoutMsComment: Liveness watchdog for one scheduler-initiated provider fetch. On timeout the candidate is terminally PROVIDER_TIMEOUT; the late fetch result is discarded, never applied.
_quantSchedulerQuantEvaluationTimeoutMsC: 2026-10-10 (P2 scheduler review): liveness watchdog for one quant-stage evaluateSymbol() call. On expiry the quant slot is quarantined (returned to the pool) while the dedup entry is kept - capacity recovers, duplicate work is impossible, and a late settle is discarded. Mirrors the fast-lane hung-lease quarantine. Generous on purpose: the data-fetch leg already ran.
_quantSchedulerQuantQuarantineMaxAgeMsCo: 2026-10-10 (P2 scheduler review): max age of a quarantined quant evaluation before the sweeper evicts it and releases the dedup entry. Bounds orphaned-work state.
_quantSchedulerExternalRegistrationMaxAg: 2026-10-10 (P2 scheduler review): max age of an external (fast-lane) evaluation registration before the sweeper evicts it. A crashed external system must not block a symbol's scheduler evaluation forever.
_quantSchedulerDedupWindowMsComment: How long a terminal outcome is remembered for singleflight dedup (symbol+fingerprint). One cycle interval: next cycle's re-admission of the same universe coalesces instead of re-evaluating.
_quantSchedulerP0DeadlineMsComment: Per-priority assessment deadlines (admission -> terminal). Past deadline while queued -> ASSESSMENT_EXPIRED; settling after deadline in flight -> ASSESSMENT_EXPIRED with evaluationSettledLate=true, never presented as current. P0/P1 deadlines align with the HIGH SLA complete target; P2 with one cycle interval; P3 is best-effort background.
_quantSchedulerSlaMsComment: User-endorsed certification targets (2026-10-09): HIGH_PRIORITY (P0/P1) admission->quant-start <=30s p95, admission->terminal <=60s p95; NORMAL (P2) admission->start <=60s p95, admission->terminal <=120s p95. Encoded in src/server/scheduling/quantPriorityScheduler.test.ts, derived from this config. Values derive from provider capacity measurements (see QUANT_SCHEDULER_CAPACITY.md).
_quantSchedulerMaxBatchWaitMsComment: Bounded wait for runQuantSchedulerBatch (one cycle's universe). Under quantCycleIntervalMs so a scheduler-driven cycle cannot overlap the next tick; the cycleGuard would coalesce anyway.
